title: Amplitude-gated heart-rate fragmentation: an exploratory incremental cross-database heart-failure prediction test
abstract: Adding the fraction of opposite-sign RR increments both exceeding20ms changed external Brier loss by +0.00074 (joint participant bootstrap95% [-0.00152, 0.01114]) beyond conventional HRV and ungated hard/soft edges. The prespecified uncertainty criterion for incremental benefit was not met.
